issue.title: Add ECS schema for user-agent ingest processor (#37727)

labels.name: :Distributed/Ingest Node
labels.description: Execution or management of Ingest Pipelines

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
(This is a forward-port with changes of #37727)

This switches the format of the user agent processor to use the schema from [ECS](https://github.com/elastic/ecs).
So rather than something like this:

```
{
  "patch" : "3538",
  "major" : "70",
  "minor" : "0",
  "os" : "Mac OS X 10.14.1",
  "os_minor" : "14",
  "os_major" : "10",
  "name" : "Chrome",
  "os_name" : "Mac OS X",
  "device" : "Other"
}
```

The structure is now like this:

```
{
  "name" : "Chrome",
  "original" : "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_14_1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/70.0.3538.102 Safari/537.36",
  "os" : {
    "name" : "Mac OS X",
    "version" : "10.14.1",
    "full" : "Mac OS X 10.14.1"
  },
  "device" : "Other",
  "version" : "70.0.3538.102"
}
```

This is now the default for 7.0. The deprecated `ecs` setting in 6.x is not
supported.

Resolves #37329

issue.title: Finalize user_agent migration to ECS

repository.name: beats
repository.description: :tropical_fish: Beats - Lightweight shippers for Elasticsearch & Logstash

issue.body:
This PR is built on top of #10472 and should be merged after it.

In 7.0, the output of ingest node "user_agent" processor will match ECS by default (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/37984, https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/38094). This means we can remove a lot of temporary field renames that were previously needed, to make its output follow ECS.

This PR will fail CI until the ES Docker image used in CI includes the changes from both issues linked above. Both of them are merged to master already, so we're just waiting for the next successful artifact build for ES.

Filebeat datasets affected:

- apache.access
- iis.access
- nginx.access
- suricata.eve (x-pack)
- traefik.access
- zeek.http (x-pack)

This PR also fixes a few mistakes that were made in ecs-migration.yml.

**Caveat**

This PR introduces multiple changes / removals of the `@timestamp` field in the test files because of an unrelated change in how Elasticsearch parses timestamps. This will be fixed in other PRs.

**TODO**

- [x] Get rid of both sets of major/minor/patch fields (ua.* and ua.os.*) in fields.yml
  - delete the fields
  - delete the aliases to these fields
  - ecs-migration.yml entries now refer to the corresponding .version field, with `alias: false`
- [x] Correct a few mistakes in ecs-migration.yml
  - Add missing entries
  - Correctly point the device field to ua.device.name
  - Remove incorrect entries (user_name under user_agent)
  - Remove obsolete comment
- [x] Reformat each set of entries to be in the same order
- [x] Rebase over #10472 once merged
- [x] Confirm build is green, once CI runs on Elasticsearch that includes this PR https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/38115

issue.title: Ingest node - user_agent, move device parsing to an object

labels.name: :Distributed/Ingest Node
labels.description: Execution or management of Ingest Pipelines

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
When the ingest node user_agent parses the device field, it
will result in a string value. To match the ecs schema
this commit moves the value of the parsed device to an
object with an inner field named 'name'. There are not
any passivity concerns since this modifies an unreleased change.

closes #38094
relates #37329

---

I am labeling this PR as both 7.0.0 and 6.7.0 , but will need a second PR for the backport since the code bases are different enough.
